lines.text: We can be sure we know Him if we keep His commandments, and we must walk as Moses walked.
The commandment is old, from the beginning, and also new, because the darkness is fading and the true light is shining.
Whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
The writer tells the young men they are strong, the word of God abides in them, and they have overcome Goliath.
Do not love the world, which is passing away, but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
